newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Draft EU resolution links EMU with jobs.
newsitem.headline: Draft EU resolution links EMU with jobs.

text.p: A draft resolution on employment prepared by the Dutch European Union presidency to go with the EMU stability pact calls for stonger links between job creation and the single currency.
A translation of the draft document obtained by Reuters also reiterates that job creation remains primarily the responsibility of EU member governments.

The draft, designed to assuage the new French Socialist government's concern about the rigourous application of teh budget pact, also calls for greater economic policy coordination between EU countries.
But another provision says economic stability is a way to create jobs.

Diplomats said it was unclear whether European Commission President Jacques Santer had proposed these resolutions to the French government on Thursday, but added it was expected to be discussed at the Franco-German meeting on Friday in Poitiers. - BRUSSELS NEWSROOM: +32 2 287-6830
